build: N1, Starting and nursery. Assumptions gains a first part, Starting and nursery: every crop grouped by how it is started (sown in the nursery, live trays, direct, bought in), with an Every crop row for the farm's germination, spare and pots a carrier, and a card for one crop: what its sowings come to (weeks before planting, trays, seed, mix, bench room), Started as, then only the parts that apply (Sowing, Potting up, For the towers, On the bench, A tray, Sown in place, Bought in), its sowings as wanted then sown, its varieties with their own germination, days from sowing to planting and seeds a cell, and Looks right. Next. Each figure is read where it is stored; three are new and read only where typed (a crop's spare, a variety's seeds a cell, one station a cell, offered with its before and after). A box being typed says under it what it would move; Enter or Tab takes it, Esc leaves it, Undo takes it back. Edit crop on Seeds opens the card; the nursery figures leave the Seeds crop and variety forms.

changes.did: Assumptions has a first part, Starting and nursery: one card a crop for its tray, seeds a cell, germination, spare and days in the nursery, what they come to, and what a change would move before it is taken.
steps: Open Assumptions › Starting and nursery and pick a crop sown in plug trays: its line reads weeks before planting, trays, seed, mix and bench room, and its sowings read wanted → sown.
Press Its own figures… beside a variety and type a germination: the line under the box says what it would move; Enter takes it and the sowings change; Undo puts them back.
On Seeds, press Edit crop on a crop: its Starting and nursery card opens.
